paras.text: **Overnight Parking of Company Vehicles.**  In addition to Tenant’s other parking rights under this Section, Tenant may park up to [OVERNIGHT VEHICLE COUNT] Company Vehicles overnight in the portion of the parking area adjacent to the Building designated by Landlord from time to time for that purpose (the “**Overnight Parking Area**”), as initially shown on Exhibit A, on the following conditions: (i) “**Company Vehicles**” means passenger automobiles, pickup trucks and cargo vans with a gross vehicle weight rating not exceeding [OVERNIGHT VEHICLE GVWR CAP] pounds, owned or leased by Tenant, currently registered and inspected, in operable condition, and used in the ordinary course of Tenant’s business at the Demised Premises; no trailers, box trucks, equipment, inoperable or unregistered vehicles, or vehicles bearing advertising other than Tenant’s own business identification are permitted; (ii) Company Vehicles shall be parked only in the Overnight Parking Area and only in marked spaces, and Landlord may relocate the Overnight Parking Area within the Project on not less than five (5) days’ notice; (iii) no washing, fueling, repair, maintenance or servicing of any vehicle, and no storage of parts, fluids or materials, shall occur anywhere in the Project, and Tenant shall promptly remediate, at its expense, any fluid leak, stain or damage to the parking area caused by a Company Vehicle; (iv) no person shall sleep in or occupy any vehicle overnight; (v) each Company Vehicle shall be covered by the automobile liability insurance required by the section of this Lease entitled “INSURANCE”; (vi) the Overnight Parking Area is not reserved or exclusive during Business Days, and Landlord may designate and sign the spaces at its discretion; (vii) Landlord may, after written notice and a failure to cure within forty-eight (48) hours (or immediately in the case of a vehicle blocking access, a fire lane or another tenant’s premises), cause any vehicle parked in violation of this Section to be towed at Tenant’s expense; (viii) Tenant, its employees and agents park at their own risk and Landlord shall have no liability for theft, vandalism or damage to any vehicle or its contents; and (ix) the rights granted in this paragraph are personal to the Tenant originally named in this Lease, are subject to the Rules and Regulations, and terminate with this Lease.
